desc: Make an AFM file from Postscript (PFB/PFA/PFM) font files using ghostscript
r: pf2afm - Make an AFM file from Postscript (PFB/PFA/PFM) font files using ghostscript
This script invokes gs(1) to make an AFM file from PFB / PFA and (optionally) PFM files. Output goes to fontfilename.afm, which must not already exist.

gs(1)
pf2afm.ps in the Ghostscript lib directory.
This document was last revised for Ghostscript version 9.54.0.
